source_basis: NCCP 00221 v5 and current EMA Giotrif sections 4.2–4.6 / patient leaflet, checked 2026-10-29. Source reconciliation is not independent clinical approval.

risks.label: Diarrhoea, dehydration and kidney problems
risks.detail: Diarrhoea can start early and become serious. Keep the prescribed symptom plan ready and contact the team promptly for persistent diarrhoea, weakness, poor drinking or reduced urine.

risks.label: Skin, nail and mouth problems
risks.detail: Rash, painful nails, dry skin and mouth soreness can affect daily life, eating and drinking. Report early; severe or peeling skin needs urgent assessment.

risks.label: Serious lung inflammation
risks.detail: New or worsening breathlessness, cough or fever requires urgent review. Suspected ILD requires a treatment hold; confirmed ILD requires permanent discontinuation.

risks.label: Rare bowel perforation and serious skin reactions
risks.detail: Severe persistent abdominal pain or blistering/peeling skin can indicate a serious complication. Seek urgent assessment; confirmed bowel perforation requires permanent stopping.

risks.label: Liver injury
risks.detail: Blood tests monitor liver function. Report yellow skin/eyes, dark urine or worsening symptoms; serious changes can require a hold or stopping treatment.

risks.label: Eye inflammation / keratitis
risks.detail: Eye pain, redness, light sensitivity or blurred vision requires prompt assessment.

risks.label: Medicine interactions
risks.detail: Give pharmacy a list of all medicines, herbal products and supplements. Some P-gp inhibitors need separated dosing; strong inducers such as St John’s wort can reduce afatinib exposure. Ask for a written individual schedule before adding or changing medicines.

risks.label: Pregnancy, contraception, fertility and breastfeeding
risks.detail: Avoid pregnancy. Women who could become pregnant need adequate contraception during treatment and for at least 1 month after the final dose. Do not breastfeed during treatment. Discuss fertility and future pregnancy plans before starting.
